title: The saved Anam persona is thrown away on every start, forcing a slow ephemeral mint (1 RTT/118B -> up to 6 RTT/29705B)
No timeout on any Anam fetch - a slow vendor hangs /avatar/start for minutes
The 6s tokenCache does not dedupe a simultaneous double-mount; two concurrent /start calls both mint
Closed/abandoned avatar popup leaks the allocated Anam session, holding a concurrency slot for future opens
Avatar video has no muted attribute; SDK relies on native autoPlay with no fallback or error surface
Avatar start-to-frame latency has zero instrumentation — every number in the waterfall is reasoned, not measured
/avatar/start re-fetches the avatar's display identity from Anam on every session start instead of caching it
B-roll absolute offsets are anchored to video_files.duration_sec, which is overwritten after the offsets are stored
One section can be emitted into broll_clips and clip_overlays at two different offsets, and the player concatenates both lists
The section query has no deterministic order, and b-roll is ordered by a column that is not its timeline position
onTick's b-roll/audio/image overlay logic is frozen to the FIRST config the player ever received, and config provably changes post-mount
Live streaming upload route admits 10 GB; nginx's documented default rejects anything over 2 GB first
Migration runner marks a file applied after its transaction rolled back
llm-pipeline-reviewer's description claims a fourth LLM provider (Groq) that does not exist; contradicts stack.md:70-71
task-tracker has no hooks: block, so it runs with unrestricted Bash and no readonly guard
Guard bypass G6: glob/brace-expanded secret paths (cat podcast-saas/.en*) defeat commandTouchesSecret in every mode including the settings.json secrets floor
Guard bypass G1: segments() does not split on a single & so any second command after it is never verb-checked in readonly mode
Guard bypass G2/G3: command substitution $(...) and backticks are not segment boundaries, giving reviewers a full shell escape behind any allowlisted verb
Guard bypass G4: awk is allowlisted with no guard on system(), getline < or |"cmd", giving arbitrary shell execution
Guard bypass G5: sed --in-place long flag evades the -i check, reopening the source-edit channel for reviewers
database-reviewer says schema.ts has 53 pgTables; the real count is 52 and stack.md:61 says 52
database-reviewer calls it a 71-file migration runner; migrate.ts:25 hardcodes 58 entries (71 is the on-disk file count)
Backend test count is 128 in stack.md and test-quality-reviewer.md:21,70; the true count today is 136
fiji.md claims FlowVid serves local media via raw path.join; server.ts:11,284,305,375,536 routes every serve through safeLocalPath(), so fiji-advisor's canonical case rests on a fixed premise
security-reviewer states 'four LLM providers'; there are three (ClaudeProvider, OpenAIProvider, GeminiProvider)
dependency-auditor states 'the four LLM SDKs'; package.json has three LLM SDKs plus groq-sdk which is ASR
Write allowlist anchors agent-memory at the repo root, denying the path the runtime actually uses (podcast-saas/client-web/.claude/agent-memory/)
Guard denies node .claude/hooks/fleet-guard.test.mjs, so fleet-maintainer cannot run the regression suite its own prompt (fleet-maintainer.md:63) mandates
fiji-advisor's mandatory Step 0 probe uses a for-loop; readonly guard denies 'for', so the agent cannot establish verified vs unverified mode
Coverage gap: podcast-saas/ops/ship/** is named by zero agent files; the only assignment is a two-owner matrix row whose owners both scope elsewhere
Coverage gap: backend-api/src/scripts/** (29 production-data scripts) is named by zero agent files; backend-reviewer's enumerated scope omits it
Only the settings.json secrets hook is firing; per-agent frontmatter readonly hooks are inactive, so the live 16-agent run has no Bash allowlist or Write confinement
A retried or restart-recovered b-roll job re-downloads and appends a SECOND timeline section
Conductor never downloads gate.json/state.json — artifact preference order picks the one artifact containing neither
pnpm backfill:storage overwrites every cloud object from local disk with no dry-run, scope limit or confirmation
Bridge generation reads its source context from the legacy prefix but publishes a copy of the active revision
stripe-webhook.controller.ts has zero tests — no proof of signature wiring, payment_status gating, or replay/idempotency
The only Playwright suite covering the real production viewer cannot run in CI and is invoked by no workflow
